findings: The rejected portrait has a tiny face inside a rigid arch and lacks flared hair ends. Enlarge the circular jaw and draw flared hair tips above broad shoulders.
plan: SQUARE (6,6)-(42,42). Mirrored hair cap and flared ends; jaw radius9 centered24,21, bottom30 touches shoulder-top34 on ink. Shared shoulder and hair attachment nodes.
references: Shared human_ref/user.svg: circular jaw and broad smooth shoulders, with contract bust ink contact. Supplied reference controls the center part and flared hair.

findings: The rejected bob is an arch continuing into the body, with an undersized face. Restore rounded bob ends, a larger circular jaw and an asymmetric side part.
plan: SQUARE (6,6)-(42,42). Rounded bob, circular jaw r9 at24,21 and shoulders top34 touching jaw ink. Deliberate side-part asymmetry.
references: Shared human_ref/user.svg: circular jaw, broad shoulders, touching bust ink. Supplied original for rounded bob and side part.

findings: The rejected car is too narrow and tall, with straight hanging wheel stems. Broaden the front, soften the roof corners and shorten the wheels while retaining lateral sensor arcs.
plan: HRECT_L (4,8)-(44,40). Symmetric compact front car, short wheels, two lateral sensing arcs. One wave per side and no tiny lamps fit the48 canvas.
references: Lucide car-front original and atomic-debug: rounded front body, sloped roof and short wheel ends. Supplied original: bilateral sensing waves.

findings: The rejected box is shallow and angular, and the hand is a rigid zigzag. Restore a taller ballot box with rounded corners and a curved grip above the upright paper.
plan: SQUARE (6,6)-(42,42). Rounded box, upright paper with top edge occluded by a rounded thumb; curved upper hand.
references: Lucide hand and hand-fist inform smooth fingers; supplied original establishes upright ballot and broad box.

findings: The rejected player has an undersized head and a nearly vertical stick, and its rear leg merges into a straight diagonal. Enlarge the head, angle the stick and restore a bent rear knee.
plan: HRECT_L (4,8)-(44,40). Head radius5 center24,13; torso neck24,26 has exact8 centerline gap. Curved forward torso, two bent legs, diagonal stick and left puck.
references: Shared human_ref/full_body_ref.png controls circular head and round-ended action limbs. Supplied original controls forward hockey pose and puck.
body:
circle('head',24,13,5)
        bez('torso',(24,26),((24,28),(29,28),(32,31)))
        path('front-leg',(32,31),(25,35),(28,40))
        path('back-leg',(32,31),(34,35),(44,40))
        path('arm',(24,26),(18,28));path('stick',(18,28),(14,38),(12,40))
        line('puck',(4,40),(4,40))
        for a,b in [('torso','front-leg'),('torso','back-leg'),('front-leg','back-leg'),('torso','arm'),('arm','stick')]:connect(a,b)
        self.mark_human_figure('player',head='head',torso='torso',torso_junction='start')

plan: VRECT_L (8,4)-(40,44). Hood radius16; circular face r7 at24,20; rounded lower blanket and two curved folds meet at24,36. Head enclosed in cloth, no detached body.
references: Shared human_ref/user.svg for circular face; supplied original for hood and overlapping blanket folds.

findings: The rejected bundle has an off-balance shallow fold crossing. Restore a centered enlarged face and two flowing wrap folds with a clear shared intersection.
plan: VRECT_L (8,4)-(40,44). Hood radius16; circular face r7 at24,20; rounded lower blanket and two curved folds meet at24,36. Head enclosed in cloth.

findings: The rejected handshake is an angular badge with no rounded gripping fingers. Restore a horizontal clasp with a rounded thumb, curved knuckle edge and visible left cuff.
plan: HRECT_L (4,8)-(44,40). Left cuff, upper right-entering hand, oblique clasp and two broad rounded finger ends; intentional asymmetric anatomy.
references: Lucide handshake original and atomic-debug: continuous rounded thumb and repeated knuckle arcs. Supplied original controls horizontal wrists.

findings: The rejected ruler is a rigid frame with four identical oversized tick marks. Use alternating major and minor graduations and restrained rounded corners so it reads as a measuring tool.
plan: HRECT_M (4,10)-(44,38), shallowest allowed envelope. Four ticks spaced8 centerline units replace six crowded source marks; alternating6 and12 lengths.
references: Lucide ruler original and atomic-debug: edge-attached graduation marks and rounded outer corners. Original horizontal orientation retained.

findings: The rejected telescope omits the entire waveform below it and has an oversized barrel. Restore the signal trace beneath a shallower horizontal optical tube and distinct lens rim.
plan: HRECT_L (4,8)-(44,40). Horizontal stepped optical tube, rim atx36, and signal trace with a shared peak at24,24. Simplify fine waveform oscillations.
